name: agent-chrome
title: Agent Chrome
description: Control system Chrome on a connected cicy-desktop host with per-profile proxy support. CDP + ~/cicy-ai/db/chrome.json multi-profile via desktop_event RPC.
author: cicy-ai

zh-CN.title: Agent Chrome
zh-CN.description: 通过 cicy-desktop 控制本机 Chrome，支持多 Profile 独立代理。使用 CDP + ~/cicy-ai/db/chrome.json。

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the active Chrome tab

tools.name: eval
tools.description: Run JavaScript in the active Chrome tab via CDP

tools.name: profiles
tools.description: List Chrome profiles; --with <service> filters to profiles tagged with / signed into that service

tools.name: account
tools.description: Record the actual account a profile holds for a service (service→accountId map in chrome.json)

tools.name: note
tools.description: Set a free-form note on a profile

tools.name: ip
tools.description: Show the profile's egress IP + country (CDP fetch through its proxy)
